text:
samir: Need a short JIT sudo window to pull a pg dump of auth-service logs for incident INC-4532. Will run local redact and not persist the raw dump. ETA ~30m, requesting 60m TTL.

jess: Which exact table / time range? Will this include email addresses/PII?

samir: Table is "service_logs" (auth-service). Time range 2026-03-10T11:00:00Z - 2026-03-10T12:00:00Z. We need raw to inspect schema alignment — log-redact pipeline can’t run this specific filter. We'll run redact tool immediately after dump and delete raw.

alex: If log-redact can't do it, need justification in the ticket and an explicit TTL. Also please list the exact commands you'll run so we can audit.

security-bot: Friendly reminder: ephemeral sudo requires a JIT request in the portal and will be logged. React with :thumbsup: to approve in-channel if oncall gives a quick ok.

marta: I can approve for 60m. Add Snow link and paste the command before you run. @samir

samir: Snow ticket: https://snow.internal/INC-4532. Command (will run from bastion):

```bash
sudo -u redwood-admin pg_dump -Fc -t service_logs --dbname=prod_logs \ 
  --where "service='auth' AND ts >= '2026-03-10T11:00:00Z' AND ts <= '2026-03-10T12:00:00Z'" \ 
  > /tmp/auth_dump.pgdump && \ 
/opt/tools/log-redact --in /tmp/auth_dump.pgdump --out /tmp/auth_dump.redacted.pgdump --anonymize-emails && \ 
cp /tmp/auth_dump.redacted.pgdump /secure-share/INC-4532/ && \ 
shred -u /tmp/auth_dump.pgdump
```

jess: Please be explicit: use the --anonymize-emails flag and do NOT upload raw dump to S3. Confirm the secure-share has restricted ACL (team-only).

samir: Confirmed: --anonymize-emails will be used. Uploading only the redacted dump to /secure-share/INC-4532 with team ACL. Raw will be shredded immediately after redact.

security-bot: Access granted: session_id=abc12345, user=samir, expires_in=3600s. Audit record: https://console.redwood/audit/abc12345

samir: Running now. Update: dump completed, redact run, redacted file copied to secure-share, raw shredded. Redacted size ~120MB. No plaintext emails found (only hashed emails).

marta: Thanks — that matches the justification. Closing the approval. Please mark INC-4532 with postmortem note about why JIT was needed and the scrub procedure used.

samir: Will add details to the ticket and link this thread. :thumbsup:
